title: Topic 3.2: The Baptism of Jesus Christ

pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE BAPTISM OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.2: The Baptism of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Baptism of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why was Jesus Christ baptised?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the importance of baptism in the life of a Christian

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: THE BAPTISM OF JESUS CHRIST
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
The Baptism of Jesus Christ helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: THE BAPTISM OF JESUS CHRIST
Study The Baptism of Jesus Christ like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: State the importance of baptism in the life of a Christian

What this means
In this part you learn to state the importance of baptism in the life of a Christian. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: state the importance of baptism in the life of a Christian.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “The Baptism of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can state the importance of baptism in the life of a Christian. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what The Baptism of Jesus Christ is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “The Baptism of Jesus Christ” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: state the importance of baptism in the life of a Christian)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach The Baptism of Jesus Christ to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: state the importance of baptism in the life of a Christian.
3. Make one local Kenya example of The Baptism of Jesus Christ from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for The Baptism of Jesus Christ: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study The Baptism of Jesus Christ?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why was Jesus Christ baptised?
2. What is the importance of baptism in the life of a Christian?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what The Baptism of Jesus Christ means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: state the importance of baptism in the life of a Christian.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
